DLC2301:4:t_003:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop wasting time on pointless chatter. The enemy is right in front of us.」

DLC2301:4:t_003:9.en:
$$アルト$$
（That way Miss $$スズネ$$ is talking...）

DLC2301:4:t_003:10.en:
$$宗介$$
（It appears we have a serious problem...）

DLC2301:4:t_003:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't just stand there either. Or did you come to watch $n struggle under the pretense of helping?」

DLC2301:4:t_003:16.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Weren't you listening, $n? I told you to wipe out the enemy before our backup arrived.」

DLC2301:4:t_003:18.en:
$$アルト$$
（Don't, $n! Don't talk back and put Miss $$スズネ$$ under any more stress!）

DLC2301:4:t_003:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
（Don't argue with Miss $$スズネ$$ when she's like this! Just let it slide and ride it out!）

DLC2301:4:t_003:20.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If you have time to make excuses, destroy another enemy instead. That's your job.」

DLC2301:4:t_003:21.en:
$n
「...Understood! I'll end this battle as quickly as possible!」

DLC2301:4:t_004:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Apparently the $$クォーター$$ has wiped out the enemy units in the area too.」

DLC2301:4:t_004:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Somehow, we managed to take the town back... Let's leave the rest to the $$連邦軍$$.」

DLC2301:4:t_004:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Good work, $n. All of you, too.」

DLC2301:4:t_004:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Why do you look so surprised?」

DLC2301:4:t_004:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...Anyway, I'm sorry. I wasn't much help during today's battle either...」

DLC2301:4:t_004:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe that first attack knocked me out for a little while... I'm really sorry.」

DLC2301:4:t_004:12.en:
$n
「It's all right. As long as you're safe, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

DLC2301:4:t_004:14.en:
$n
「Let's head back. We don't have time to get carried away over today's victory.」

DLC2301:4:t_004:16.en:
$n
（That's right... Miss $$スズネ$$'s stress, all of it... The $$新地球皇国$$ is to blame...）

DLC2301:4:t_005:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Nicely done. Keep it up, and exterminate the enemy.」

DLC2301:4:t_005:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't surrender our freedom to invaders.」

DLC2301:4:t_005:2.en:
$n
（She's not wrong... Though that's a pretty extreme way of putting it...）

DLC2301:4:t_005:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong? Do you need a reward to get motivated?」

DLC2301:4:t_005:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Are you going to make a woman spell it out?」

DLC2301:4:t_006:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So this is the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$... Not bad.」

DLC2301:4:t_006:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Show me you can master it, $n. Or else...」

DLC2301:4:t_006:3.en:
$n
「You don't need to worry about that! I swear on $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s soul that I'll fight with this power!」

DLC2301:4:t_100:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Look, the enemy's here. Fight properly.」

DLC2301:4:t_100:2.en:
$n
（$$サイデリアル$$... The $$新地球皇国$$... Has the stress of fighting driven Miss $$スズネ$$ this far...?）

DLC2301:4:t_101:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What an irritating bunch... Finish them off already.」

DLC2301:4:t_101:2.en:
$n
（$$サイデリアル$$...! To protect Miss $$スズネ$$'s heart, I won't let you run loose any longer!）

review.context: Allies recognize Suzune's harsh alternate personality and advise Hibiki not to argue. After combat Suzune reverts with no memory; alternate battle exchanges show her threats, flirtation and pressure to master the Sphere.
decisions: Advent is the deceased person invoked in Hibiki's oath, so the pilot glossary token is used.
Reward dialogue retains its sexual implication without inventing a specific act.
Short reaction questions and ellipses remain deliberate conversational fragments.
